name: Destiny Fails Us: A New Life
source:
Idril is a girl that has trouble with her grades, loves strawberries, and would rather spend her time playing video games. When she brings a bad report card home, how will her strict mother react?

Suddenly, romance, school work, and friendships have become more complicated, and Idril must take a step back to reassess her life. 

What will become of Idril’s teenage years?
